_comment: Per-city rules for extract_transit_hubs.py. Most cities need no rules at all,
because their stations carry no network/operator tag or because the extract
does not spill into a neighbour. Hong Kong does: geofabrik's 'hongkong'
extract also contains Shenzhen, and Shenzhen sits inside Hong Kong's bbox,
An entry of null means no filter on that axis for that city.
IMPORTANT: keepOperators here must not match Hong Kong's Shenzhen joint
ventures (港铁轨道交通（深圳）etc). Those are Shenzhen lines operated by an
MTR joint venture, not Hong Kong stations, and a loose 'MTR' substring match
would silently pull in 41 Shenzhen stations.
